purpose: Retain the original Share receipt-wait failure state before the existing batch defer and uninstall cleanup, then rethrow the same error.

observation.timing: Only after original polling error; no added reads in success/poll paths.
observation.serialization: Identities, enum status, count, boolean, numeric timing. Generations use exact decimal strings. No shared text, result contents, source or error-message serialization.
observation.errorPreservation: Snapshot read/encoding failures are contained; the original catch rethrows its original error.
observation.ownership: MainActor synchronous local function. Existing public session getters return copied String identifiers; no session/context is retained.

limitations: Sequential state observations are not an atomic snapshot.
Process-global session IDs are not proof that the VM belongs to this Share invocation.
The existing receipt API may create/open its original transaction lock and decode a receipt. Only selected scalar fields are serialized; no custom queue mutation or broad disk scan is added.
The existing lock acquisition is bounded to 10 seconds; filesystem read/encoding cost is not a new hard wall-clock guarantee.
The original deadline and assertion remain unchanged. A post-failure observation can delay subsequent cleanup.
No cause or repair of the native Share timeout is established; actual Apple compiler/test acceptance remains required.
